# from template(fugue, @tyger_burning_bright, subject=ode_to_joy, counter=pachelbel_violin): a fugue at 104 in B minor, the phrase sung in it (templates v1)
# phrase: @tyger_burning_bright, "Tyger! Tyger! burning bright / In the forests of the night," (The Tyger (Songs of Experience), stanza 1, ll. 1-2, William Blake, 1794)
# vocal: 14 syllables, free, straight feel, stress x~x~x~xx~x~x~x: a vocal line of 4 bars, sung over sections of 8 bars
# subject: ode_to_joy; the theme that enters, is answered a fifth up and re-enters transposed
# counter: pachelbel_violin; the countersubject, drawn toward the subject
tempo 104
key bm

# the drums: the drm_* parts are what the arrangement changes; the kick and the shaker stay put
let kick4 = x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_snr = ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_hat = ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~
let shk = x ~ x x ~ x x ~
# subject, bound: ode_to_joy
let dux_1 = f#4 ~ ~ ~ f#4 ~ ~ ~ g4 ~ ~ ~ a4 ~ ~ ~
let dux_2 = a4 ~ ~ ~ g4 ~ ~ ~ f#4 ~ ~ ~ e4 ~ ~ ~
let dux_3 = d4 ~ ~ ~ d4 ~ ~ ~ e4 ~ ~ ~ f#4 ~ ~ ~
let dux_4 = f#4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ e4 ~ e4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let dux = <dux_1 dux_2 dux_3 dux_4>
# counter, bound: pachelbel_violin
let countersubject_1 = f#5 ~ ~ ~ e5 ~ ~ ~ d5 ~ ~ ~ c#5 ~ ~ ~
let countersubject_2 = b4 ~ ~ ~ a4 ~ ~ ~ b4 ~ ~ ~ c#5 ~ ~ ~
let countersubject = <countersubject_1 countersubject_2>
# the vocal line: a degree of the key for each syllable, ! on the stressed ones
let vox_a = 1! 2 1! 2 1! 2 3! ~
let vox_b = 3! 4 5! 4 5! 6 8! ~

# subject: the theme alone
section subject 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=75..90
  deck B: melody dux inst=organ vel=60..80
}

# answer: it enters again a fifth up while the first voice goes on
section answer 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=80..95 | hihat drm_hat kit=drums vel=40..60
  deck B: melody dux inst=organ vel=60..80 | arp transpose(dux, 7) inst=sax vel=55..75
}

# counter: a third voice against the two, the bass the subject two octaves down
section counter 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=85..100 | clap drm_snr kit=drums vel=60..80 | hihat drm_hat kit=drums vel=45..65 | bass octave(dux, -2) inst=bass vel=70..85
  deck B: melody dux inst=organ vel=60..80 | arp transpose(dux, 7) inst=sax vel=55..75 | harmony countersubject inst=flute vel=45..65
}

# sung: the phrase over the subject in the bass
section sung 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=75..90 | hihat shk kit=drums vel=30..45 | bass octave(dux, -2) inst=bass vel=65..80
  deck B: harmony countersubject inst=flute vel=25..40 | melody <vox_a vox_b ~ ~> inst=kalimba oct=3 vel=24..38
  deck B: sing "/t ie g er/ / /t ie g er/ / /b er n ii ng - b r ie t/ / in the /f aw r ii s t s/ of the night" on melody voice=robot-choir
}

# the subject re-enters transposed, down and back up, while the countersubject morphs toward it
arrange {
  subject
  answer
  ~ countersubject_* morph dux_1 0.25
  counter
  ~ dux_* down 2
  sung
  ~ drm_* grow
  answer
  ~ dux_* up 2
  ~ countersubject_* morph dux_3 0.2
  counter
  @ vox_* xfer shk
  sung
  ~ drm_* decay
} loop 3 then end
